💗 提示词模板技能：
🔪这组第一人称pov镜头的小视频提示词模板技能，发给agent，把想法变成完整的提示词，想要的小伙伴评论区拿

💗 164节点大佬亦诚视觉开发的：
🔪参数不需要动，主要解决高动态视频噪点问题，小伙伴根据个人需求开关。
🔪124节点：使用8步加速lora的话这里步数就是8，也可根据个人需求自行增加步数获得更高质量的视频

💗 注意事项：
🔪加速方法乱花迷眼，主要是注意力机制和lora两种加速方法，也可以串联，小伙伴们自行取舍测试，不要的就ctrl+b。
🔪后期社区加速方法稳定后再调整

💗 127节点注意事项：
🔪模型选择上日益丰富，原版模型fl2va和ref2va、融合模型自行测试，后面抽空做一期模型测试

💗 136节点注意事项：
🔪参考图1连线image_0，依次往下数连上一张自动出现下一个连接点
 🔪最下方的值match还是max根据自己需求，质量和时间是反比，根据个人需求调节

💗 资产加载注意事项：
🔪根据使用场景首尾帧、文生、首帧、多参选择127节点加载合适的大模型
🔪选择节点136连接的资产种类。
🔪依次增加提示词、一张图、两张图、多张图、+视频、+音频，最多9张图、3个视频和音频。

Shot 1（0:00-0:02）· 快速扫视洞房
First-person male POV, the groom's red scholarly wedding robe with gold-thread embroidered double-happiness pattern, right thumb wearing a plain silver seal ring, shoulders visible in frame but face remains outside the frame. Ancient bridal chamber at night, dragon-phoenix wedding candles on table with flames reflecting on red gauze curtains, wedding bed with red brocade bedding and red gauze canopy, window with double-happiness paper cutouts and moonlight outside, bronze mirror, fruit platter, and wedding wine cups on vanity, overall warm red and gold color palette with flickering candlelight. Medium shot to medium close-up transition, subjective eye-level perspective, rapid panning camera movement, cinematic sense of speed. Camera rapidly pans from left to right across the bridal chamber — dragon-phoenix candle flames flickering, red gauze curtains glowing warm red in candlelight, fruit platter and wedding wine cups flashing by, then the pan settles on the bride's silhouette sitting on the edge of the wedding bed — the blurred outline of her red wedding dress and red veil in the center of the frame, candlelight haloing on the red fabric of the veil. Night time, indoor bridal chamber, flickering candlelight. Warm red dominant tone, gold candle flame highlights flickering, red curtains with rich light-transmitting layers, high contrast. Photorealistic cinematic quality, 35mm film, fine grain, motion blur from rapid panning, candle flame volumetric light. 16:9, 8K, ultra HD

Shot 2（0:02-0:04）· 喜秤挑盖头
First-person male POV, the groom's right hand holding a red-silk wedding scale pole extending into the center of the frame, wide red sleeve with gold-thread double-happiness embroidery, silver seal ring on thumb reflecting candlelight. Ancient bridal chamber at night, candle flames reflecting on red gauze curtains, bride sitting on edge of wedding bed. Bride in red wedding dress with gold-thread phoenix embroidery, wearing phoenix crown with tassels and red veil covering her face. Medium close-up, subjective eye-level perspective, the wedding scale pole rapidly lifts upward then the footage abruptly slows down, fast-to-sudden-slow contrast camera movement. The groom's right hand holding the red-silk wedding scale pole extends from the bottom of the frame, the pole tip catching the edge of the red veil, rapidly lifting upward — the red veil flies off the bride's head and floats away, the moment the veil drifts in the air the footage abruptly slows down, the bride's face gradually emerging as the veil flies away — first the phoenix crown tassels, then her forehead, then her eyes and brows appearing in the candlelight. Night time, indoor bridal chamber, flickering candlelight. Warm red dominant tone, when veil lifts the candlelight transmits through the red fabric creating intense red translucency, after veil flies away the bride's face is directly illuminated by warm golden candlelight, high contrast. Photorealistic cinematic quality, 35mm film, physically realistic veil floating dynamics, smooth fast-to-slow speed transition, candlelight volumetric light. 16:9, 8K, ultra HD

Shot 3（0:04-0:06）· 烛光下初见美人
First-person male POV, the groom's gaze looking straight forward, wide red sleeve at the bottom edge of the frame. Bride with oval face, willow eyebrows, almond eyes with dense long lashes, lips like dotted cherry, skin like congealed jade fair and translucent, wearing phoenix crown with tassels, red wedding dress with gold-thread phoenix embroidery, personality delicate and shy. Ancient bridal chamber at night, dragon-phoenix candle light coming from the side. Close-up, subjective eye-level perspective. The main visual subject is the bride's face — candlelight coming from the right side, warm golden light outlining her right cheek contour, left cheek in soft shadow. The bride's phoenix crown tassels swaying slightly, her eyes cast down, eyelashes casting fine dense shadows in the candlelight. Then she slowly raises her eyes — long lashes lifting, the moment her almond eyes meet the camera, her lip corners trembling slightly, a faint blush spreading from her ear to her cheek. Night time, indoor bridal chamber, flickering candlelight. Warm golden side light from the right, bride's right cheek bright left cheek in soft shadow, phoenix crown tassels glinting gold, candle flame reflecting as small light points in her pupils, high contrast warm tone. Photorealistic cinematic quality, 35mm film, extremely shallow depth of field with sharp face and blurred background, fine translucent skin texture, candlelight volumetric light, clear eyelash shadows. 16:9, 8K, ultra HD

Shot 4（0:06-0:09）· 喊相公+邀请解衣
First-person male POV, the groom's wide red sleeve and silver seal ring at the bottom edge of the frame. Bride with oval face and willow eyebrows and almond eyes, red wedding dress with gold-thread phoenix embroidery, gold silk tassel sash at waist. Ancient bridal chamber at night, flickering candlelight. Close-up, subjective eye-level perspective, camera remains on the bride's face. The main visual subject is the bride's face — she slightly tilts her head, lips parting as she softly speaks "相公，替奴家解衣", her voice extremely soft and gentle, after speaking her eyes cast down with shyness, a faint blush spreading from her ear to her cheek. The camera holds steady on her face, capturing her shy expression after the invitation. Night time, indoor bridal chamber, flickering candlelight. Warm golden candlelight from upper right, wedding dress gold threads shimmering, skin translucently white in candlelight, overall warm gold and red tone. Photorealistic cinematic quality, 35mm film, shallow depth of field, luxurious silk wedding dress texture, rich gold embroidery details, realistic lip trembling and blush detail. 16:9, 8K, ultra HD

Shot 5（0:09-0:13）· 凑近审视身材+直接解衣
First-person male POV, the groom's gaze looking at the bride, wide red sleeve at the bottom edge of the frame. Bride with oval face, willow eyebrows, almond eyes, red wedding dress with gold-thread phoenix embroidery, gold silk tassel sash at waist, graceful figure with beautiful curves, slender waist. Ancient bridal chamber at night, flickering candlelight. Close-up, subjective eye-level perspective, camera slowly pushes forward while moving downward following the groom's gaze. The primary purpose of this shot is the groom examining and appreciating the bride's beauty and figure. The camera starts on the bride's face in close-up: her oval face, downcast almond eyes with long lashes, lips like cherry, skin like congealed jade. The camera slowly pushes forward and moves downward — approaching closer while moving from her face to her shoulders where the red wedding dress gold-thread phoenix embroidery collar sits, then down to her chest where the red silk fabric with gold embroidery drapes over her graceful figure, then settling on her upper body in close-up. The forward push creates an intimate, appreciative gaze — the groom savoring the bride's beauty and good figure. The red wedding dress fabric shimmers with gold threads in candlelight, the dress cut accentuating her beautiful figure and elegant curves. The bride remains still, eyes lowered, a faint blush on her cheeks. The examining of her figure is the primary focus, occupying most of the shot. After the examining is complete, the groom's right hand with silver seal ring reaches in from the left side of the frame, fingers directly finding the gold silk sash knot at her waist and pulling it open — this undressing action is secondary, a direct follow-through after the examining is done, not the main purpose. The shot ends as the sash knot comes undone and the outer garment begins to loosen. Night time, indoor bridal chamber, flickering candlelight. Warm golden candlelight from upper right, gold embroidery shimmering, silk fabric with rich texture and sheen, skin translucently white in warm light, the wedding dress silhouette emphasizing her graceful figure, overall warm gold and red tone. Photorealistic cinematic quality, 35mm film, shallow depth of field, slow smooth forward push combined with downward pan, luxurious silk and gold embroidery texture, candlelight volumetric light. 16:9, 8K, ultra HD

Shot 6（0:13-0:15）· 外衣脱掉后后拉胸像+"相公"定格
First-person male POV, the groom's right hand with silver seal ring and red sleeve at the bottom edge of the frame. Bride in moon-white close-fitting thin inner garment, the red outer wedding dress having been removed. Ancient bridal chamber at night, candlelight from the side. Medium close-up, subjective eye-level perspective, camera slightly pulls back, then freeze frame. The main visual subject is the bride's bust portrait — the outer garment has been removed, the bride now in her moon-white inner garment. The camera slightly pulls back to reveal the bride's upper body bust portrait range: her downcast almond eyes with long lashes, lips like cherry, the graceful line of her neck, her collarbone, and the moon-white inner garment draping over her shoulders and upper body. Candlelight rests on her fair skin and the moon-white fabric creating a soft warm golden halo. The moon-white inner garment fits close to her body, the candlelight tracing the graceful curves of her figure through the thin fabric. Then the bride softly and shyly calls out "相公" — her voice extremely soft and gentle, her eyes cast down with shyness, a faint blush spreading from her ear to her cheek. The frame freezes on this beautiful, tender moment — the bride in her moon-white inner garment, her shy expression, the candle flame flickering on the right side. This shot's purpose is to showcase the bride's beauty after undressing, ending on her shy call. The shot ends here. Night time, indoor bridal chamber, flickering candlelight. Warm golden candlelight from the side, moon-white inner garment appearing warm white in candlelight, skin with soft candlelight reflection, the graceful neckline and collarbone beautifully lit, overall warm gold and soft white tone. Photorealistic cinematic quality, 35mm film, shallow depth of field, slight pull-back camera movement, freeze frame, candlelight volumetric light. 16:9, 8K, ultra HD, freeze frame
